title: FastAPI service returns 500 on startup after dependency bump
description: After upgrading pydantic from v1 to v2, the FastAPI app crashes on startup with a 500 and 'PydanticUserError: ... is not fully defined'. Response models using v1-style config fail to build.
resolution: Migrate models to Pydantic v2: replace class Config with model_config = ConfigDict(...), run bump-pydantic, and call model_rebuild() for forward-referenced models. Pin pydantic>=2.5.

title: KeyError on startup reading configuration
description: Application raises KeyError: 'DATABASE_URL' at boot when reading os.environ directly. The variable is missing in the new environment and there is no default.
resolution: Read config with os.environ.get and validate at startup with a clear error, or load a .env via python-dotenv. Add DATABASE_URL to the deployment's env/secrets.

title: gunicorn worker timeout under load
description: Under load, gunicorn workers are killed with 'WORKER TIMEOUT' and requests return 502. Long synchronous handlers block the worker.
resolution: Increase --timeout, add more workers, and move blocking I/O off the request path (async or a task queue). Use gthread/uvicorn workers for concurrency.

title: Postgres 'too many connections' from connection pool exhaustion
description: Service intermittently fails with 'FATAL: sorry, too many clients already' from PostgreSQL. Each request opens a new DB connection.
resolution: Use a bounded connection pool (SQLAlchemy pool_size/max_overflow) or PgBouncer. Ensure connections are returned to the pool; cap total connections below the server limit.

title: Docker build fails: no matching distribution / pip 403 behind proxy
description: CI Docker build fails resolving Python deps with 403/404 from an internal package index. The lockfile points at an internal mirror unreachable from the build.
resolution: Force the public PyPI index for the build (uv: [[tool.uv.index]] url=https://pypi.org/simple default=true; pip: --index-url), re-lock, and confirm no internal mirror URLs remain in the lockfile.

title: 401 Unauthorized calling a Google API from a container
description: Calls to a Google Cloud API return 401/403 from a deployed container. No credentials are attached to the outbound HTTP client.
resolution: Use Application Default Credentials: attach an OAuth token via google.auth.default() (user locally, the runtime service account when deployed). Grant the service account the required IAM role.

title: Kubernetes pod CrashLoopBackOff: container port mismatch
description: Pod stays in CrashLoopBackOff and the LoadBalancer never becomes healthy. The server listens on 8080 but the readiness probe and Service target a different port.
resolution: Align the containerPort, the server's listen port ($PORT), and the probe/Service targetPort. Have the app bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT.

title: CORS error: preflight blocked in browser
description: Browser requests fail with 'No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header' on the preflight OPTIONS request to the API.
resolution: Enable CORS on the server (FastAPI CORSMiddleware) with the correct allow_origins, allow_methods, and allow_headers; handle OPTIONS.

title: JWT 'signature has expired' after clock skew
description: Auth intermittently fails with 'Signature has expired' even for fresh tokens. Server and client clocks drift by tens of seconds.
resolution: Sync clocks with NTP and add a small leeway when validating exp/nbf (e.g. leeway=30s). Don't set token lifetimes shorter than the skew.

title: OOMKilled: container exceeds memory limit processing large payloads
description: Container is OOMKilled (exit 137) when handling large request payloads; it loads the whole body into memory.
resolution: Stream/chunk large payloads instead of buffering, cap request size, and raise the container memory limit to a realistic value.

title: Endpoint returns 500 from an unawaited coroutine
description: A POST endpoint intermittently returns 500 for valid input. The handler calls an async function without awaiting it, so a coroutine object is used where data is expected and the event loop logs 'coroutine was never awaited'.
resolution: Await the coroutine (result = await do_work()), make the handler async def, and add a timeout with asyncio.wait_for. Enable RuntimeWarning for un-awaited coroutines in tests.

title: Clients report a bug but the API returns 422 Unprocessable Entity
description: Callers say the service is 'broken', but logs show 422 responses, not 5xx. FastAPI is rejecting requests whose body fails schema validation (missing/mistyped fields).
resolution: 422 is a client-side validation error, not a server bug. Return a clear error body listing the invalid fields, document the schema, and fix the caller's payload.

title: 413 Request Entity Too Large from the ingress proxy
description: Large uploads fail with 413 before reaching the app. The load balancer / nginx has a lower body-size limit than the service expects.
resolution: Raise the proxy body-size limit (e.g. client_max_body_size) to match the app, or switch large uploads to resumable/streamed uploads to object storage.

title: 307 redirect loop from trailing-slash and HTTP/HTTPS mismatch
description: Requests bounce in a redirect loop. FastAPI redirects '/items' to '/items/', and a proxy that terminates TLS redirects back to HTTP, creating a cycle.
resolution: Match the client path to the route (with/without trailing slash), set redirect_slashes consistently, and configure the proxy to preserve X-Forwarded-Proto so the app builds HTTPS URLs.

title: Async route stalls all requests via a blocking synchronous call
description: P99 latency spikes and unrelated endpoints slow down. An async route makes a blocking call (requests.get / heavy CPU) that starves the single event loop thread.
resolution: Use an async client (httpx.AsyncClient) or offload blocking work with asyncio.to_thread / a worker pool. Never call blocking I/O directly inside async def.

title: Background task swallows exceptions silently
description: A fire-and-forget background task fails but the request returns 200 and nothing is logged. The exception is lost because the task result is never awaited or logged.
resolution: Wrap background work in try/except with logging, or use a task queue with retries and a dead-letter. Attach a done-callback that logs task exceptions.

title: 403 PERMISSION_DENIED: service account missing IAM role
description: A deployed service gets 403 PERMISSION_DENIED calling another Google Cloud API even though credentials are attached. The runtime service account lacks the required IAM role.
resolution: Grant the runtime service account the least-privilege role it needs (e.g. roles/aiplatform.user) on the target resource, then redeploy. Verify with 'gcloud ... test-iam-permissions'.

title: OAuth access token expires mid long-running request
description: Long operations fail partway with 401 as a cached OAuth access token expires during the request. The client never refreshes the token.
resolution: Use an auth library that auto-refreshes (google.auth transport), or check expiry and refresh before each call. Don't cache tokens past their expires_in minus a safety skew.

title: JWT rejected: audience/issuer mismatch after config change
description: All tokens are rejected with 'Invalid audience' after an environment change. The verifier's expected aud/iss no longer matches what the identity provider issues.
resolution: Align the verifier's expected audience and issuer with the IdP configuration for this environment; load them from config, not hard-coded constants.

title: mTLS handshake fails: peer certificate not trusted between services
description: Service-to-service calls fail with 'certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate'. The client doesn't trust the CA that signed the server's mTLS cert.
resolution: Distribute the internal CA bundle to clients (mount the trust store / set SSL_CERT_FILE), ensure certs include the right SANs, and rotate before expiry.

title: Service account key committed to the repository
description: A JSON service account key was checked into git and flagged by secret scanning. Long-lived keys are a standing credential-leak risk.
resolution: Revoke the leaked key immediately, purge it from history, and switch to keyless auth (Application Default Credentials / Workload Identity). Store any unavoidable secrets in Secret Manager.

title: 429 Too Many Requests from a shared API key
description: Requests intermittently fail with 429 during peak. Multiple services share one API key and collectively exceed its rate quota.
resolution: Give each service its own key/identity, request a quota increase, and add client-side rate limiting with backoff. Prefer per-service service accounts over shared keys.

title: Spanner DEADLINE_EXCEEDED on reads under load
description: Read requests to Cloud Spanner time out with DEADLINE_EXCEEDED during peak traffic. Queries scan too much data and the default deadline is too short.
resolution: Add covering/secondary indexes, narrow the query, raise the RPC deadline moderately, and use stale reads for non-critical paths to cut latency.

title: Spanner transaction ABORTED from lock contention
description: Read-write transactions fail with ABORTED under concurrency. Multiple transactions contend for the same rows and Spanner aborts to break the conflict.
resolution: Keep transactions short, read only what you write, order writes consistently, and rely on the client library's automatic retry of ABORTED transactions.

title: BigQuery 'Quota exceeded' during peak analytics
description: Analytics queries fail with 'Quota exceeded: Your project exceeded quota for concurrent queries'. Too many large queries run at once.
resolution: Use reservations/slots or a queue, reduce concurrency, materialize/cache repeated results, and prune scanned bytes with partitioning and column selection.

title: Latency spike from N+1 query pattern
description: An endpoint issues one query per item in a loop, so latency grows linearly with result size. Under load this saturates the database.
resolution: Batch the access: a single IN/JOIN query or a dataloader that coalesces lookups. Eager-load related rows instead of querying per item.

title: Full table scan from a non-sargable filter
description: A query is slow because a WHERE clause wraps the indexed column in a function (e.g. LOWER(email)=...), preventing index use and forcing a full scan.
resolution: Make the predicate sargable: store a normalized/computed column and index it, or add a functional index. Avoid functions on indexed columns in WHERE.

title: Stale reads from read-replica lag
description: Users occasionally don't see data they just wrote. Reads are served by a replica that lags the primary by seconds.
resolution: Route read-after-write to the primary, or use bounded-staleness/strong reads for those paths. Communicate eventual consistency where it's acceptable.

title: Postgres deadlock detected on concurrent updates
description: Concurrent updates fail with 'deadlock detected'. Two transactions lock the same rows in opposite order.
resolution: Acquire locks in a consistent order, keep transactions short, and add a retry on deadlock. Consider SELECT ... FOR UPDATE with a deterministic ordering.

title: Spanner client session pool exhausted
description: Requests block or fail with 'no sessions available' as the Spanner client's session pool is exhausted under load. Sessions aren't returned promptly.
resolution: Size the session pool for peak concurrency, use context managers so sessions are released, and avoid holding sessions across slow external calls.

title: Pub/Sub messages processed twice (no idempotency)
description: Downstream side effects happen twice for some events. Pub/Sub guarantees at-least-once delivery, so redelivered messages are reprocessed.
resolution: Make consumers idempotent: dedupe on a message/business key stored transactionally, or use exactly-once delivery on the subscription. Never assume single delivery.

title: Pub/Sub redelivery storm from too-short ack deadline
description: Messages are redelivered repeatedly and the backlog grows. Processing takes longer than the subscription's ack deadline, so Pub/Sub assumes failure and redelivers.
resolution: Extend the ack deadline (or use modAckDeadline/lease management), reduce per-message work, and increase concurrency so messages are acked before the deadline.

title: Pub/Sub messages stuck: subscriber never acks on error
description: A subscription's unacked count climbs and messages are stuck. On an exception the handler returns without ack or nack, so messages wait for the deadline every cycle.
resolution: Nack on failure (or let the exception propagate so the client nacks), ack only on success, and route repeat failures to a dead-letter topic.

title: Event ordering violated without an ordering key
description: Downstream state is corrupted because events for the same entity are processed out of order. The publisher didn't set an ordering key.
resolution: Publish with an ordering key per entity and enable message ordering on the subscription, or make the consumer order-independent using versioned/last-write-wins updates.

title: Dead-letter topic filling from a poison message
description: A malformed message fails every delivery attempt and, once dead-lettering is enabled, floods the dead-letter topic while blocking progress.
resolution: Validate/parse defensively and drop-or-quarantine unparseable messages, set a sane max delivery attempts, and alert on dead-letter volume for triage.

title: Task lost when worker crashes (early ack)
description: Occasionally a queued task never completes after a worker restart. The worker acknowledges the task before finishing, so an in-flight task is lost on crash.
resolution: Acknowledge only after the work succeeds (ack-late/visibility timeout), make tasks idempotent, and enable retries so an interrupted task is redelivered.

title: Fan-out storm overwhelms a downstream service
description: One incoming event triggers thousands of outbound calls, overwhelming a downstream dependency and causing cascading 5xx.
resolution: Batch or throttle fan-out, add a concurrency limit and backpressure, and smooth bursts through a queue instead of calling downstream synchronously.

title: Redis eviction storm evicts hot keys under memory pressure
description: Cache hit rate collapses and latency spikes. Redis hits maxmemory and the eviction policy discards hot keys, sending load to the database.
resolution: Right-size Redis memory, choose an appropriate maxmemory-policy (e.g. allkeys-lru), set TTLs to bound working set, and shard/scale before the ceiling.

title: Thundering herd on cache miss stampedes the database
description: When a popular key expires, many requests miss simultaneously and all recompute it, hammering the backend.
resolution: Use a single-flight lock or request coalescing so one caller recomputes while others wait, add jittered TTLs, and serve stale-while-revalidate.

title: Stale data served: cache never invalidated on write
description: Users see outdated values after updates. Cached entries have no TTL and writes don't invalidate the cache.
resolution: Invalidate or update the cache on write (write-through or delete-on-write) and set a TTL as a safety net so staleness is bounded.

title: Redis connection pool exhausted under load
description: Requests fail with 'connection pool exhausted' or timeouts to Redis during peak. Connections aren't reused or released.
resolution: Use a shared bounded connection pool, reuse the client, set sensible timeouts, and cap total connections below Redis maxclients.

title: Cache key collision from non-namespaced keys
description: Two features read each other's cached values because they use overlapping, non-namespaced keys (e.g. 'user:1' means different things).
resolution: Namespace keys by feature and version (e.g. 'billing:v2:user:1'), include all identifying dimensions, and centralize key construction.

title: Latency from serializing large objects into Redis
description: Cache reads/writes are slow because large blobs are serialized into single Redis values, saturating network and memory.
resolution: Cache only what's needed, compress or split large values, store big blobs in object storage and cache a reference, and watch value sizes.

title: Cloud Run cold-start latency with min instances at zero
description: First requests after idle are slow (multi-second) because Cloud Run scales to zero and cold-starts the container, including heavy imports at startup.
resolution: Set min-instances >= 1 for latency-sensitive services, trim startup work and lazy-load heavy deps, and use startup CPU boost.

title: GKE pod OOMKilled: memory limit set too low
description: A pod is repeatedly OOMKilled (exit 137) and restarts. Its memory limit is lower than real usage, so the kernel kills it under normal load.
resolution: Measure actual usage and set requests/limits accordingly, fix leaks/oversized buffers, and add memory-based alerts. Keep requests close to limits for stable scheduling.

title: Cloud Run throttling: max instances too low
description: Under a traffic spike requests queue and time out. The service's max-instances cap is reached and Cloud Run throttles new instances.
resolution: Raise max-instances (within quota), tune concurrency per instance, and load-test to size limits. Add autoscaling headroom for spikes.

title: Image pull fails: Artifact Registry permission denied
description: Deployment fails to start with 'denied: Permission artifactregistry.repositories.downloadArtifacts'. The runtime service account can't pull the image.
resolution: Grant the deploy/runtime service account roles/artifactregistry.reader on the repository, and confirm the image path and region are correct.

title: Rollout stuck: readiness probe path is wrong
description: A new revision never becomes ready and the rollout stalls. The readiness probe points at a path/port the app doesn't serve, so it always fails.
resolution: Point the probe at a real health endpoint and the correct port, give it a sensible initialDelay/timeout, and verify the app returns 200 there.

title: Container blocked by policy: image runs as root
description: Admission control rejects the pod because the image runs as root, violating the platform's security policy.
resolution: Add a non-root USER in the Dockerfile, set runAsNonRoot/runAsUser in the pod spec, and use a minimal hardened base image.

title: Works locally, fails in prod: env var missing from manifest
description: The service runs locally but fails in production because a required environment variable set in a local .env was never added to the deployment manifest.
resolution: Declare all required env vars in the deploy manifest/secrets, validate presence at startup, and keep .env for local development only.

title: Memory leak: unbounded in-memory cache grows until OOM
description: Memory climbs steadily over hours until the container is OOMKilled. An in-process dict cache grows without bound and is never evicted.
resolution: Bound the cache (LRU with a max size and TTL), move shared cache to Redis, and add memory metrics to catch growth early.

title: Lost update from a read-modify-write race
description: A counter/balance ends up wrong under concurrency because two requests read, modify, and write the same value without synchronization.
resolution: Use an atomic operation (DB UPDATE ... SET x=x+1, or a compare-and-swap), or a transaction with row locking, instead of read-modify-write in application code.

title: Deadlock from inconsistent lock ordering
description: The service occasionally hangs when two code paths acquire locks A and B in opposite orders, deadlocking under concurrency.
resolution: Acquire locks in a single global order everywhere, use a timeout on lock acquisition, and minimize the critical section.

title: Duplicate side effects without a distributed lock
description: Two instances process the same job concurrently and both perform the side effect (e.g. double charge/email). There is no cross-instance mutual exclusion.
resolution: Guard the critical section with a distributed lock or a uniqueness constraint, and make the operation idempotent with an idempotency key.

title: Fire-and-forget asyncio task is garbage-collected
description: Work started with asyncio.create_task sometimes never runs to completion. The task reference isn't kept, so it can be garbage-collected mid-flight.
resolution: Keep a reference to created tasks (store them in a set, discard on done), await them, or use a task group/queue so they aren't collected early.

title: Thread-unsafe global mutated under concurrency
description: Intermittent corrupted state appears under load because a module-level mutable global is read/written by multiple threads without a lock.
resolution: Avoid shared mutable globals; use request-scoped state, thread-local storage, or a lock/queue around the shared structure.

title: Duplicate processing from a missing idempotency key
description: Retried requests create duplicate records because the write path has no idempotency key, so a retry after a timeout inserts a second row.
resolution: Require an idempotency key on mutating requests, store it with a uniqueness constraint, and return the original result on replay.

title: Pydantic v2 rejects payloads that v1 accepted
description: After a library upgrade, requests that used to succeed now fail validation. Pydantic v2 is stricter about coercion (e.g. str-to-int) than v1.
resolution: Decide the intended contract: relax with explicit validators/coercion where appropriate, or fix callers to send correct types. Document the stricter schema.

title: Datetime serialized without timezone causes off-by-hours bugs
description: Timestamps are wrong across regions because naive datetimes (no tzinfo) are serialized and interpreted as local time by different consumers.
resolution: Store and serialize timezone-aware UTC datetimes (ISO-8601 with offset), convert to local only at display time, and never use datetime.now() without a tz.

title: Floating-point precision errors in money calculations
description: Totals are off by a cent because monetary amounts are computed with binary floats, which can't represent decimal fractions exactly.
resolution: Use decimal.Decimal (or integer minor units) for money, quantize to the currency's precision, and never sum floats for financial values.

title: UnicodeDecodeError reading non-UTF-8 input
description: Processing fails with UnicodeDecodeError on some files/messages because the input isn't UTF-8 but is decoded as UTF-8.
resolution: Decode with the correct declared encoding, handle errors explicitly (errors='replace' where acceptable), and normalize to UTF-8 at the boundary.

title: Schema drift: a new required field breaks old clients
description: Adding a required field to a response/request schema breaks older clients that don't send or expect it, causing validation failures.
resolution: Evolve schemas backward-compatibly: add new fields as optional with defaults, version the API, and deprecate before removing.

title: Enum value from client not recognized by server
description: Requests fail because a client sends an enum value the server's enum doesn't include (a newer or misspelled value).
resolution: Validate against the enum and return a clear error, treat unknown enum values as a defined 'unknown' fallback where safe, and keep client/server enums in sync via a shared schema.

title: Large JSON response blows up memory (no pagination)
description: An endpoint that returns all rows spikes memory and latency as data grows, occasionally OOMing the instance.
resolution: Paginate (limit/offset or cursor), stream the response, and cap the maximum page size. Never load an unbounded result set into memory.

title: TLS certificate expired: outbound calls fail handshake
description: All calls to a dependency suddenly fail with 'certificate has expired'. The server's TLS certificate lapsed and was not rotated.
resolution: Rotate/renew the certificate, automate renewal (e.g. cert-manager/ACME), and alert well before expiry. Never pin to a cert that isn't auto-renewed.

title: Intermittent failures from stale DNS caching
description: Requests intermittently fail after a dependency's IP changes because the client caches DNS entries longer than the record's TTL.
resolution: Respect DNS TTLs, avoid caching resolved IPs in long-lived clients, and re-resolve on connection errors. Use a service name, not a hard-coded IP.

title: Retry storm amplifies a downstream outage
description: A brief downstream blip turns into a full outage because every client retries aggressively at once, multiplying load (retry amplification).
resolution: Use exponential backoff with jitter, cap retries, add a circuit breaker, and only retry idempotent operations.

title: Requests hang: no timeout on outbound HTTP client
description: Worker threads/event loop slots are exhausted because outbound HTTP calls have no timeout and hang when a dependency is slow.
resolution: Set explicit connect and read timeouts on every outbound client, fail fast, and combine with retries/backoff and a circuit breaker.

title: 'Connection reset by peer' from keep-alive mismatch
description: Intermittent ECONNRESET errors occur because the client reuses keep-alive connections that the server or proxy has already closed (idle timeout mismatch).
resolution: Set the client's keep-alive/idle timeout below the server's, enable retry on connection reset for idempotent calls, and tune pool recycling.

title: Proxy strips headers: wrong client IP and scheme
description: Rate limiting and HTTPS URL building break because a reverse proxy doesn't forward X-Forwarded-For/Proto, so the app sees the proxy IP and http scheme.
resolution: Forward and trust X-Forwarded-* from the proxy, enable proxy headers middleware (uvicorn --proxy-headers), and restrict trusted proxy ranges.

title: Log flooding: debug logging left on in production
description: Logging costs and disk usage spike because verbose DEBUG logging was left enabled in production, drowning signal and inflating bills.
resolution: Set log level from config (INFO+ in prod), sample or rate-limit noisy loggers, and emit structured logs so volume is controllable.

title: PII leaked into application logs
description: Emails, tokens, and other PII appear in logs because request/response bodies are logged verbatim, creating a compliance risk.
resolution: Redact/blocklist sensitive fields before logging, never log auth tokens or full bodies, and add a logging filter that scrubs known PII patterns.

title: Cannot trace a request: no correlation/trace id
description: Debugging a cross-service failure is impossible because requests carry no correlation id, so logs across services can't be joined.
resolution: Propagate a trace/correlation id (W3C traceparent) through all calls, include it in every log line, and adopt distributed tracing.

title: Metrics cardinality explosion from unbounded labels
description: The metrics backend degrades and costs spike because a metric uses high-cardinality labels (user id, request id) creating millions of series.
resolution: Remove unbounded labels, bucket values, and keep label sets low-cardinality. Use exemplars/traces for per-request detail, not metric labels.

title: Health check green while the service is degraded
description: Load balancers keep sending traffic to a broken instance because the health check only checks process liveness, not real dependencies.
resolution: Add a readiness check that verifies critical dependencies (DB, cache) with timeouts, and separate liveness from readiness so degraded instances drain.
